messages:
Nadia Brooks: Quick flag 1010  - BeaconRail (renewal in ~5 weeks) dropped to near-zero inference calls after Friday. They were steady at ~8k tokens/day before. Raising for triage.
Alex Park: Noted. Any signs of billing or champion churn?
Samir Patel: Their CTO moved teams last week; procurement also asked for an architecture security review. I see a support SR about revoked API keys (SR-9993). No 5xx from our side.
Nadia Brooks: Sounds like an auth/config pause + stakeholder change. Procurement demo'd Velox.ai yesterday (they liked the on-prem angle). We should surface a quick plan: 1) short unblock token (IP-limited, 48h), 2) offer a one-time 20k token credit + SE tune, 3) 20-min joint security/infra call to walk IdP and keys.
Alex Park: Agree. Also prepare a 1-page TCO that highlights our failover and burst capacity vs Velox's on-prem pitch. Keep it internal.
Samir Patel: I'll assemble the perf notes and a <150-word outreach. Also adding a tiny warmup curl for infra to reduce cold starts:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/run -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":1}'
```
Samir Patel: Perf note: p95 ~120ms on hosted region-us-west over last 30 days. I'll paste the chart into the shared folder.
Nadia Brooks: Legal Bot 8FYI	 : any constraints on offering credits or short-term token exceptions?
Legal Bot: Standard playbook allows credit up to 25k for churn-risk accounts with CSM+AE approval. For token issuance with IP restrictions, file RD-990 and include an expiry date.
Alex Park: I'll file RD-990 and draft the outreach. Nadia, can you lead the call with their new security lead? Offer the IP token and SE tune on the call and mention we can put a canary back in 24-48h if metrics look good.
Nadia Brooks: Scheduling a 20-min unblock call for Wed 11am PT. Draft outreach (short):
"Hi Jordan, noticed BeaconRail's API traffic paused after the key rotation. We can issue a short IP-restricted token and run a quick perf tune to unblock integration tests. Can we grab 20 mins Wed 11am PT?
—Nadia (CSM)"
Samir Patel: Outreach looks good. I'll prep the perf slides and the canary rollout steps (rollback plan + metrics to watch).
ticket-bot: SR-9993 linked to renewal task BR-401. Priority set to HIGH by Nadia Brooks.
Nadia Brooks: Thanks all. If usage doesn't resume within 7 days of the unblock call we'll escalate to AE for exec outreach. Closing interim thread; will update after the call.
